sonnet.problem: This passage is mostly genealogy and name lists, so it counts as a long stretch. Card 4 asks the baker for a name in that list (who Basemath's father is). Nothing in the story gives the baker a way to reason it out, so it can only be guessed.
sonnet.rule: Choice cards ask only about what the text says a thing is for, what someone says, anything that happens, and short stories inside it. Never about measurements, materials, counts or names.
